title: Research: sharp eight-transfer threshold with free source-port choice
body:
PR #1498 leaves six-transfer sufficiency open for the universal five-source batch with two dirty connectors and freely chosen source ports. This contribution excludes six and, with Cinna Davis's credited eight-transfer word from [Discussion1412](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1412), establishes a sharp threshold of **eight one-way transfers at the minimum 72 A/B calls**. No selected supplier or kappa changes.

The new exclusion covers **242,161,920 canonical B/C skeletons**, including every source-port assignment. Two separately implemented complete enumerations agree on every histogram bin: 74,692,800 skeletons restore both connectors, and none covers all 32 source masks. Their maximum coverages by source-port partition are 31, 31, 28, 22, 23 and 31. The README proves the reduction from arbitrary-dirty schedules to this finite domain and the padding/parity implication for fewer transfers.

The eight-transfer construction is **Cinna Davis's**, independently replayed here after exchanging connector names. The new result goes beyond that discussion's restricted source-port premise. The complete bill is 72c + 8σ + H_new under equal complete A/B port prices; it beats the achieved 74-call old repair only if 8σ + H_new − H_old < 2c. The added dirty row, fixed-port contracts, transfer implementation and remaining overhead are explicitly charged.

Validation on macOS arm64, CPython 3.12.13 and Apple clang 21.0.0:

- Both full native censuses and all exact histograms agree.
- Twelve small C++ cross-checks; a third set-valued Python oracle on eight domains; Richardson's 945-pairing control.
- Free noncommutative forward/inverse replay; 380 dense basis columns per direction; 570 transfer-tape columns per direction.
- All 87 failure controls rejected, including all 80 individual instruction omissions.
- Package metadata/source pins and the explicitly upper-bound-only registered replay passed; clean application to refreshed main.

Full replay, including the exclusion:

```sh
python3.12 -I -O -B research/two-connector-six-transfer/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_TWO_CONNECTOR_SHARP_EIGHT_TRANSFERS`. The package includes exact receipts and a dedicated native CI workflow. The generic registered hook uses `--witness-only` and explicitly does not certify the exclusion. No full selected-frontier replay, supplier admission, human peer review, Lean theorem or new multiplication exponent is claimed.

Selection base: `ebedc0895eb4c06725af020bc1af165722b0a3ce`; rebased onto `81e81af67714bdc8d1693b0bf5c29468b92f62ff`. Revision-2 assignment nonce `7de5e5ad11c402a85f5db9a8f499cac5`, refined `connector-alphabet-change`; the card is unchanged in priority revision 3. Final overlap refresh covered 735 open PRs and 244 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings. Coverage limits and precise predecessor heads are retained in TASK.json. [Coordination claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1486#discussioncomment-18914235).

Credit Gareth Davidson (@bitplane), PR1498 at `b7baacc8048ab11d31751aee065206f2725a1a16`; woklerx, PR1438 at `a61170c97c9ea2c396f6d76a953b0cf74a455cdd`; Cinna Davis, Discussion1412; and Ross Richardson, PR943/934. Predecessor source text and provenance are retained. Prepared by Hanson Sun (@bbMisk) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
